dnb_icu.text: NBEMS DNB Anaesthesiology curriculum: ICU posting 4 months, within a 3-year recommended rotation schedule.

md_icu.text: NMC MD Anaesthesiology guideline: 4 months ICU (2 months supervised in early years, 2 months independent in last six months); suggested schedule also lists ICU 4.

dnb_rotations.text: DNB rotations: Obstetrics 3, Neurosurgery 2, Paediatric surgery 2, CTVS/cath lab 1, Pain 1, PACU 1, General Surgery 6 months; mandatory thesis and signed logbook.

duty_hours.text: MoHFW 1992 Residency Scheme: max 12 hours continuous duty, 48 hours/week; PGMER-2023: reasonable hours, one weekly off. Supreme Court PIL pending (NMC affidavit Aug 2026).

stipend_min.text: From 1 June 2025, post-MBBS DNB minimum stipend is Rs 43,000/45,000/47,000 per month (years 1-3). Private hospitals pay this or the state rate, whichever is higher.

bond_rule.text: NBEMS-accredited hospitals cannot take security deposits, security bonds or caution bonds in any form. Only state-government district DNB hospitals may impose a service bond, with NBE approval.
